correctness.rationale: Every closed one-run leaves integer discrepancy between -b and -1, with positivity before later runs because a>b. The initial marker has a legal first one-run of length a+1 and then a second run of exactly q. Any internal imitation of the first run has at least b+1 preceding zeros, and exact inequalities force precisely b+1. Its residual differs by delta in [1,b-1] from the initial residual. The congruence am=bq+b-1 makes its forced second run q+1, not q. Thus the marker is a generating-prefix-only factor; the language lemma rules out every return word. Finite state checks passed for 47 coprime parameter pairs at depths up to 150; this is corroboration, not a proof.

value.rationale: Transitivity classification is an explicitly stated open question for this natural non-sofic frequency-shift family. Resolving every rational parameter in (1/2,2/3) fills an infinite dense parameter interval left open by the known integer-ratio and high-ratio statements. The constructive two-run arithmetic obstruction captures a structural memory effect and determines non-return in the entire interval, rather than an arbitrary handpicked parameter.
